bridge.when: About 30 years later (the early first century CE)
text: The child who spoke from his mother's arms has grown up. Isa, known as Jesus, is honoured in Islam as one of the greatest messengers. He was born without a father by God's command, and he is a servant of God, not God.
His miracles, the Quran says again and again, happen by God's permission. The chapter ends as the Quran tells it: he was not killed, but raised up to God.
